visualCharacteristics: New: stacked full-width filled bars (light grey) with bold title and a maroon chevron at the right, separated by small gaps; panel holds rich text (paragraphs, lists, h3, tables). No existing accordion variant.

usage.description: Expandable sections shown as stacked grey title bars with a chevron; each opens a rich-text panel. Use for entry pathways, policies and program lists.

reuseGuidance: Use when long content can be grouped under short titles that readers scan before opening. Keep titles as plain text (no headings); panels take any rich text.
tableStructure: One row per item: cell 1 title (plain text), cell 2 panel content (paragraphs, headings, lists, links, tables)
